reviews.outcome: A definite-Horn SLD entry is supported by existing unification, first-order lifting and least-model semantics. A corpus proof can derive ground completeness from finite least-model stages rather than introducing the source GCNF calculus. SLD completeness is distinct from termination or completeness of depth-first execution. GALLIER-SLD-01 records a local goal-transcription slip. No new entry adoption.
